thread:
sam_g: Hey team — vendor just pushed a soft ETA update for the EU surge order (120 H100s). They say earliest ship window 2/14-2/18 but customs + FRA depot could add 3-5 business days. Need a plan for partial handoffs + RMA handling if units arrive DOA.
jess_prod: Thanks. Do we have a breakdown by region? We only asked for 40 EU-west + 80 EU-central.
oliver_ops: FRA depot is our default for EU-central. If customs slows, we can cross-dock to NL hub once cleared. That adds a day but reduces thermal risk.
anna_proc: @lars_vendor can you confirm whether replacements (DOA) are covered under a 30-day on-site swap or return-to-vendor? Also need AWB and HS codes upfront for customs pre-clearance.
lars_vendor: Anna — replacement policy is 14-day RMA window for DOA with depot repair or swap; we can do courier swap but that’s premium. HS codes: 8471.90.80, AWB will be standard carrier. Photo evidence + serials required for depot credit.
sam_g: If premium courier is required for swap, what's the ballpark surcharge per unit vs depot repair credit? Need cost estimate to compare against our risk.
lars_vendor: Premium swap ~ €1,200/unit (express door-to-door). Depot repair route: you ship back, repair or replace, vendor issues credit; inbound freight and customs on your side unless we prepay — adds ~€350/unit net depending on weight.
jess_prod: If we accept depot path, we need a temporary loaner pool to avoid capacity gaps in EU regions while replacements process. Any chance of a short-term loaner list?
oliver_ops: We have ~12 spare H100s in NL hot pool. Could front 8-10 for critical clusters, but that drains redundancy. Suggest prioritizing top 3 customers first.
anna_proc: Also need to confirm warranty paperwork flow: will vendor issue RMA numbers before customs clearance so depot can pre-authorize credit on arrival? That would speed things.
lars_vendor: We can pre-issue RMAs after initial photo + serial verification. Pre-auth means depot can triage on arrival; if customs holds, RMAs still valid for 30 days.
rma_bot: NOTICE: Please attach photos in a single thread and include serials in format: S/N:XXXX-XXXX for automated intake.
sam_g: Good. Two operational asks: 1) list of serials for the first 40 units leaving staging by EOD tomorrow; 2) temporary loaner agreement covering warranty liability and shipping credits.
jess_prod: I'll draft a short loaner SOW — duration, liability cap, return SLA. Ollie, please propose which clusters to prioritize if we only front 8 spares.
oliver_ops: Prioritize prod-eu-apps, infra-training, and logging ingestion clusters. I'll post a short matrix by noon.
anna_proc: Lars, if we route through FRA depot but cross-dock to NL, can you cover inbound customs brokerage? That avoids us juggling multiple broker payments.
lars_vendor: We can offer consolidated brokerage for the FRA->NL cross-dock at €75/unit extra. Otherwise you handle brokerage per country.
sam_g: Ok — preferred path: ship to FRA depot -> pre-issue RMAs on photo/serial -> cross-dock to NL hub for rapid loaner dispatch where needed. Anna, can you finalize SOW + procurement approval with those numbers? We need decision by 16:00 CET to lock shipping.
anna_proc: On it. I'll include options: (A) premium swap all DOA (€1,200/unit) or (B) depot + loaner + brokerage add-on (~€425/unit net + loaner shipping). I'll ask finance to quick calc expected burn if DOA rate 3%.
jess_prod: FYI — if DOA >5% we should trigger vendor penalty clause (discussed in contract). Keep that in the SOW.
oliver_ops: Also, can we get vendor to include depot photo log (3 angles) and thermal log for each serial on arrival? That helps forensic & warranty claims.
lars_vendor: We can include arrival photo pack and attach basic thermal sensor summary for bulk shipments. Detailed per-unit thermal logs not standard but can be requested.
sam_g: Perfect. Once Anna posts SOW I'll review and approve. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
